audience: creators who sell memberships on Patreon and want to check their patrons, tiers and posts

useCases.title: Review tiers and patron counts
useCases.text: List your campaigns with their tiers and patron counts. Open one campaign to read its summary and patron count.

useCases.title: Check patron status and charge dates
useCases.text: List the patrons of a campaign with their status, last and next charge dates and tiers. Open one membership to read its charge history.

useCases.title: Compare lifetime support across patrons
useCases.text: List the patrons of a campaign with their lifetime support and current entitlement. Names can be empty when a patron hides them.

useCases.title: Review recent posts and paid access
useCases.text: List the posts of a campaign with their titles, publish dates and access flags. Open one post to read its HTML content.

useCases.title: Find your profile and campaign id
useCases.text: Read your Patreon profile and the campaigns you own. Use the campaign id in the other tools.
